title: Empty, blank and non-string ids
policy: P4: an id that is empty, only whitespace, not a string, or null is missing. A record with no usable id gets a fingerprint.
derivation: req_30a with an empty message id, twice (output 1, 2): one incomplete operation [10, 2]. Blank ids, the same record twice: one fingerprint [20, 2]. A numeric message id with req_30b: incomplete [30, 3]. msg_30c with a null request id: incomplete [40, 4]. An array and an object as ids: fingerprint [50, 5]. Both empty: fingerprint [60, 6]. Input 210, output 22, 6 operations, 232: 3 incomplete, 3 fingerprinted.
